entries.title: Revelation of John 6:1
segments: Then I saw the Lamb break one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four Creatures crying with a voice like thunder--'Come.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:2
segments: And in my vision I saw 'a white horse.' Its rider held a bow, and he was given a crown, and he went out conquering and to conquer.

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:3
segments: When the Lamb broke the second seal, I heard the second Creature crying--'Come.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:4
segments: Then there went out another horse, 'a red horse,' and to its rider was given the power to deprive the earth of peace, so that men should kill one another; and he was given a great sword.

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:5
segments: When the Lamb broke the third seal, I heard the third Creature crying--'Come.' And in my vision I saw 'a black horse.' Its rider held scales in his hand.

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:6
segments: And I heard what seemed to be a voice, coming from among the four Creatures, crying--'A quart of wheat for a florin, and three quarts of barley for a florin! But do not harm the oil and the wine.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:7
segments: When the Lamb broke the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth Creature crying-- 'Come.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:8
segments: And in my vision I saw a grey horse. His rider's name was Death, and the Lord of the Place of Death rode behind him; and power was given them over the fourth part of the earth, so that they might 'destroy with sword and famine and death, and by means of the wild beasts of the earth.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:9
segments: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the sake of God's Message and for the testimony which they had borne.

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:10
segments: They cried in a loud voice--'How long, O Sovereign Lord, holy and true, before thou wilt give judgement and avenge our blood upon all who are living upon the earth?'

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:11
segments: Then to each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to rest yet a little longer, till the number of their fellow-servants and of their Brothers who were about to be put to death, as they had been, should be complete.

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:12
segments: And I saw the Lamb break the sixth seal, and then there was a great earthquake. The sun became black, like sackcloth, and the moon, which was at its full, like blood.

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:13
segments: 'The stars of the heavens fell' to the earth, as when a fig-tree, shaken by a strong wind, drops its unripe fruit.

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:14
segments: The heavens disappeared like a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved from its place.

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:15
segments: Then all the kings of the earth, and the princes, and the generals, and the rich, and the powerful, and every slave and free man, 'hid themselves in the caves and under the rocks' of the mountains;

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:16
segments: and they are crying to the mountains and the rocks-- 'Fall upon us, and hide us from the eyes of him who is seated on the throne, and from the Wrath of the Lamb,

entries.title: Revelation of John 6:17
segments: for the great Day of their Wrath is come, and who can stand to meet it?'
